scope: Single-target summaries for retrieval and implementation planning. Full source rules remain authoritative. This file is not an executable rules configuration.

cards.label: Взаимодействовать
cards.check: Usually none; use a specific action/check where required.
requirements: Object or terrain is accessible; appropriate hands can manipulate it.
effects: Move an existing object, change grip, open an operable door or comparable manipulation.

cards.label: Искать скрытое

cost.scope: GM determines the searchable area and can adjust the cost.

cards.dc: Stealth DC of a hidden creature, or object detection DC.
effects: Reveal detections according to degree and available senses; not every detected creature becomes observed.

cards.label: Оценить поведение
cards.dc: Target Deception DC, a relevant mental effect DC, or another appropriate DC.
cards.retry: Normally requires a significant change in situation.

outcomes.critical_success: Determine intentions and gain an idea of relevant mental magic.
outcomes.success: Assess whether behavior is normal, without precise intentions.
outcomes.failure: Perceive the intended impression; a nondeceptive target appears normal.
outcomes.critical_failure: Receive a false impression of intentions.

cards.label: Расположить к себе
cards.scope: Single-target reference; consult the full rule for multiple targets.
cards.duration: Normally the current social interaction unless the GM decides otherwise.
cards.restriction: Does not determine a player character's attitude or choices.

cards.label: Попросить услугу
requirements: Request is acceptable in context; some requests remain impossible.
cards.dc: GM sets difficulty for this particular request.

outcomes.success: Agreement, potentially with conditions or modifications.
outcomes.critical_failure: Refusal and attitude worsens one step.

outcomes.critical_success: Compliance with nonharmful directives for GM-determined duration, at most one day; subsequent unfriendly attitude; short-term retaliation prevented.
outcomes.success: As critical success, but later retaliation is possible.
outcomes.failure: No compliance; attitude becomes unfriendly unless already unfriendly or hostile.
outcomes.critical_failure: No compliance; hostile attitude; temporary immunity to Coerce for at least one week.

cards.label: Деморализовать
requirements: Aware of a target within 30 feet.
modifiers: A -4 penalty when not speaking an understood language.
cards.retry: Target is immune to this actor's Demoralize for 10 minutes regardless of outcome.

cards.label: Помочь с проверкой

cost.preparation: Usually at least one action; task-dependent.

requirements: Triggering skill check or attack roll.
cards.statistic: GM selects an appropriate skill or attack roll.
cards.dc: Usually 15; GM can adjust for the task.

outcomes.critical_success: Circumstance bonus +2, or +3 for master / +4 for legendary proficiency.

cards.scope: Applies to the specific triggering check, not a permanent bonus.

cards.label: Открыть силой
modifiers: Prying without a crowbar normally imposes a -2 item penalty.

outcomes.critical_success: Open; can avoid damaging the obstacle.
outcomes.success: Force open and break the obstacle; unusually sturdy obstacles may only take damage.
outcomes.critical_failure: Jam it; later Force Open attempts take a -2 circumstance penalty.

cards.label: Вскрыть замок
requirements: Held or worn thieves' toolkit, or GM-approved improvised picks treated as shoddy.
cards.progress: Lock quality can require multiple successes.

outcomes.critical_success: Unlock, or add two successes; no traces.
outcomes.success: Unlock, or add one success; detectable traces.
outcomes.critical_failure: Break the toolkit and leave obvious damage.

cards.label: Украсть незаметно
requirements: Automatic failure if the owner is in combat or on guard.
cards.dc: Usually owner Perception DC, with protection adjustments; observers may also matter.

outcomes.success: Transfer an existing object without the relevant observer noticing.
outcomes.failure: Attempt noticed before taking it; GM determines response.

cards.label: Необычная заявка

cost.policy: Use the closest defined action; an undefined quick action generally costs one or two actions.

requirements: Situation-specific ruling with appropriate traits, skill/DC if needed, and bounded consequences.
effects: Apply the accepted ruling; a one-off exception need not establish an unlimited ability.
